title: REPORT on how to secure a sustainable future for the EU livestock sector in light of the need to ensure food security, farmers’ resilience and the challenges posed by animal diseases?
part_text: ‘Notes that the FAO’s 2023 report entitled “Contribution of terrestrial animal source foods to healthy diets for improved nutrition and health outcomes” highlights the role of animal-based foods in providing high-quality protein and essential micronutrients that may be lacking in plant-based diets;’
